 Kalyan Jewellers Q2 net profit jumps 64 pc to Rs 427 cr 
 Revenue from operations grew 32 per cent in the second quarter of FY27 to Rs 10,323 crore, compared to Rs 7,856 crore in the same period a year ago. PTI

 Mumbai, Jewellery retailer Kalyan Jewellers India on Tuesday reported a 64 per cent year-on-year growth in consolidated profit after tax (PAT) to Rs 427 crore during the September quarter of the current fiscal. The Thrissur-headquartered company's net profit stood at Rs 260.51 crore during the corresponding quarter of the preceding financial year, Kalyan Jewellers said in a regulatory filing. Revenue from operations grew 32 per cent in the second quarter of FY27 to Rs 10,323 crore, compared to Rs 7,856 crore in the same period a year ago. For the first half of FY27, the company's net profit grew 48 per cent to Rs 776 crore against Rs 525 crore in the year-ago period. It recorded a 38 per cent rise in revenue to Rs 20,912 crore against Rs 15,125 crore in the first half of FY26. "The ongoing festive quarter has started off very well and we are very encouraged by the growth on the ground, especially during Navratri and Dhanteras. We are upbeat about the wedding season and look forward to ending the quarter on a strong note," Kalyan Jewellers India Executive Director Ramesh Kalyanaraman added. Comments
